# README Assets

Optional visual assets for the root `README.md`. The README currently ships
without banner images; if you add these files, re-insert the matching `<img>`
tags in `README.md` to render them.

| File | Size (suggested) | What it is |
|------|------------------|------------|
| `banner.png` | 1280×400 @2x (2560×800) | Hero banner at the top of the README |
| `hero-before-after.png` | 1200×600 @2x | Side-by-side: what a human sees vs. what a scraper sees |
| `demo.gif` | 1000×500 | Screen capture of the live demo (typing → encoding → font renders) |
| `variants.png` | 1200×600 @2x | Grid of the four variants (Inter / Datatype / Syne / Young Serif) |
| `logo.svg` | square, mono | Small mark, favicon-friendly |

Keep assets under 500 KB each where possible; GitHub compresses but slow
first loads hurt the first impression.
